Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.

content_sections.heading: Delhi University Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Delhi University Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 18-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Delhi University to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Delhi University Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Delhi University Guest Faculty recruitment is 18th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Guest Faculty post in Delhi University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree with at least 55% marks in Lifelong Learning and Extension/Allied subjects and have cleared the UGC NET examination.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 1500 per lecture, with a maximum monthly earning of Rs. 50000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online through the official Delhi University website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is DCEE/2026/.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The selection will be made by a Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age limit specified for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limit for these positions.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the direct links to the official notification PDF and the online application form in the "Important Links" section of this article.
